tools.name: get_quiz_questions
tools.description: Return Tonebook’s eight categorical self-assessment questions. Ask for the user’s own choices; do not infer choices from a photo or conversation history. No account, photo or payment is needed.

tools.name: score_color_quiz
tools.description: Use eight explicit user-selected answers to suggest a 12-color starting palette and adjacent option. Uncertain or conflicting preferences prompt clarification. The versioned result is unconfirmed guidance, not a diagnosis. It never overwrites a confirmed palette.

tools.name: select_palette
tools.description: Return a portable user-confirmed palette from an explicit season choice. For correction, pass the prior palette reference so source and revision are retained. Confirm only the user’s stated choice. Keep the new reference for later calls; this does not write account or native report data.

tools.name: compare_colors
tools.description: Compare up to 12 supplied six-digit hex colors or standard color names with a portable selected palette. Unknown or ambiguous names request hex values. Return the nearest digital swatch with a fixed RGB rule and concise rationale. This does not assess skin, photos, fabrics or garments you own.

tools.name: create_palette_board
tools.description: Generate a labeled downloadable SVG board and matching 12-color PNG from a user-confirmed palette, a chosen outfit/event/packing purpose and optional supplied garment colors. Requires the user’s chosen palette; unknown colors request clarification. Computation only; no upload, charge, account record

tools.name: get_palette_board
tools.description: Reconstruct the same SVG, PNG, selected palette and supplied-color comparisons from a complete board reference. Anyone with a reference can read its public palette data. It is not an account credential and cannot retrieve purchased reports. No Tonebook server record is required.
